product_metadata.title: Sealy Posturepedic Memory Foam Fitted Mattress Protector – Memory Foam Layer Adds Comfort and Support - Protection Against Spills and Stains - Machine Washable, Queen, 60”x80
features: CRADLES TO YOUR BODY - Add a layer of cozy comfort to your mattress with the Sealy Washable Memory Foam Fitted Mattress Protector. This ½” thick memory foam mattress protector cradles your body for added support while you sleep.
BREATHABLE FABRIC - Stay comfortable and cool all night long! Sealy’s Washable Memory Foam Fitted Mattress Protector has moisture-wicking technology that keeps you cool and dry throughout the night.

EXTEND MATTRESS LIFE - Encasing your mattress with a durable and comfortable memory foam mattress protector adds a protective layer between the sheets and your mattress. It provides waterproof protection so spills and stains don’t ruin your mattress, keeping it fresh and clean for years to come!

EASY ON, EASY OFF - This 78” x 80” fitted mattress protector fits a king bed and stretches to fit 18” deep mattresses. The easy on and easy off design makes this mattress protector a practical and comfortable addition to your bed.
MACHINE WASHABLE - Sealy’s Memory Foam Fitted Mattress Protector is made of a unique machine washable foam. For easy care, machine wash and tumble dry low for long-lasting clean!
description: Are you craving a cozy, comfortable mattress that contours to your body but also want waterproof protection against accidental spills and stains? Let the Sealy Washable Memory Foam Fitted Mattress Protector help you! This luxurious mattress protector has moisture-wicking technology that keeps you cool and dry throughout the night. The ½” thick memory foam cradles your body for added support while you sleep. Sealy’s Washable Memory Foam Fitted Mattress Pad measures 60” x 80,” fitting a queen-sized mattress. It stretches to fit mattress up to 18” deep and is designed to be easy on, easy off. It is made of a unique machine washable foam. For easy care: machine wash and tumble dry low for long-lasting clean! Let Sealy’s Washable Memory Foam Fitted Mattress Protector extend the life of your mattress! Covering your mattress with our durable and comfortable memory foam mattress protector adds a layer between the sheets and your mattress, protecting it from inevitable stains and spills. Plus, it comes with a 10-year limited warranty, ensuring that you are comfortable and protected for many years to come!
